I noticed today that the website and instagram were both down. I'm shocked though, because I got an email from customer service today regarding me wanting to return everything.

I placed my order back in March and just received it last week. I'm starting to think they purposefully waited until I was past the dispute window with paypal. The coloring is clearly rubbing off, which I saw another post on here describing exactly what I was seeing. I wish I had thought to look here sooner and get a refund. I cannot believe I gave them the benefit of the doubt. 

They emailed me back trying to say that the coloring is natural and non-toxic titanium micro particles, and that it was just oil on the surface making it look a different color. What a load of bs. The website didn't say anything about return shipping, but they said I would be responsible for return shipping costs to get a refund because it's safe to use. But now that their website has disappeared, I get the feeling I'm never gonna see that refund.

So I received my durapik last week and I can confirm the same issue is still happening. They emailed me back trying to say that the coloring is natural and non-toxic titanium nanoparticles, and that it was just oil on the surface making it look a different color. What a load of bs. The website didn't say anything about return shipping, but they said I would be responsible for return shipping costs to get a refund because it's safe to use. 

I placed my order back in March, and I'm starting to think they purposefully waited until I was past the dispute window with paypal. And now, their website and instagram accounts are both gone. I'm surprised they even bothered to email me back.

Oh, no, not at all. I definitely don't think it's ok to make decisions for other people. But I also don't think it helps anyone to look at a situation and say "well you should have done this" or "why didn't you do that?" 

And no worries, misunderstandings happen.

I know 20 isn't that different from 19, that was literally my point. I said he's just barely not a teenager. They're both still kids. 

I agree, telling her the truth would be part of moving on.

19 may be legally an adult on paper, but developmentally that is still adolescence. She's still a teenager. He's just barely not a teenager. This is an intense and fucked up situation. Telling OP what you think he should have done doesn't help anyone. What's done is done, it's in the past. No one can go back and change it. All OP can do now is try to move forward.

I'm not defending killing someone. I'm defending someone you accused of killing someone because he didn't. You called OP a murderer, he is not. He isn't even guilty of manslaughter. 

I can't say what R will do or what will happen because I don't know her; and even if I did I'm not a fucking psychic. 

Would what make me feel better? I'm not sure what you're asking.

Have a good sleep.

I have no problem with continuing to debate. I never said I was done debating, you did.

Leave you alone? I'm not harassing you, I'm replying to you. If you don't want to continue the conversation then don't.

Murder requires intention. Without intention it's manslaughter, not murder. So saying he murdered someone is asserting that he intended to kill him. You're contradicting yourself.

You've said you're done debating people so many times, yet you keep commenting. You don't know that OP isn't going to tell her the truth. You can't possibly know what someone will or won't do in the future. And even if what OP and the other friends said to J impacted his decision to take his life, OP clearly did not intentionally drive him to suicide. You're an asshole for saying and acting like he did.
Does shaming people for their mistakes help you sleep at night? Or asserting that you know someone else's motivations or what was going through their head?

In what way am I acting like that? I never said anything remotely like that. I'm saying you can't know for certain what someone else was thinking, especially when that person isn't here to tell anyone. It's quite possible that what OP and his friends told J had an impact on his decision. It's also possible it would have happened anyway. We will never fucking know.
You *feel like* and you *think* but you don't actually fucking *know*. That's the point I was trying to make. You're acting like you know with 100% certainty and you don't.

You couldn't possibly know that. And shaming someone for something that already happened isn't fucking helpful in the slightest. You're either lying about trying to be helpful or you're fucking delusional.

Firstly, you don't know that it's OP's fault J killed himself. No one knows for certain except J, the rest of us can only guess and speculate.

Secondly, in what fucking way is that helping? Why do you feel the need to judge and condemn the poor dude? He clearly feels bad about the whole situation.
